sourceManifest.subtype: wide-leg shorts with overlapping hip panels
sourceManifest.fit: Very wide, flared legs with pronounced front folds and a comparatively fitted waistband.
sourceManifest.construction: Two separate short legs with finished hems, a curved waistband, central button-and-fly closure, two visible belt loops, curved front pocket openings, and large overlapping hip panels. Deep folds extend down the legs; these are not treated as separate sewn panels.
sourceManifest.materialEvidence: Dark indigo-black fabric has a visible denim-like weave, stiff folded edges, subtle yarn variation, and contrasting brown double-row topstitching.
uncertainties: Exact fiber composition cannot be established visually.
The precise attachment and hidden extent of the overlapping hip panels are not visible.
Pocket interiors are partly obscured by the overlapping panels.
The fly outline is visible, but the underlying fastening mechanism is concealed.
On-body length and fit cannot be confirmed from the flat garment.

All 13 source region IDs have visible counterparts in this redraw; no source ID has been dropped or new ID added.

The redraw extends both hip-overlay tips into narrow curled shapes farther down the outer legs than the source bounds indicate. These are mapped to the existing overlay IDs, but their exact construction is uncertain.

Additional long parallel lines along both outer legs appear to continue the overlay-edge stitching toward the hems; this construction detail is not established by the source observations.
